edition.notes: Catalog-level record created 2026-07-25. Correspondence volume containing Bellarmine's letter to the Roman College mathematicians of 19 April 1611 (no. 515), their reply of 24 April 1611 (no. 520), and Bellarmine to Galileo of 23 June 1612 (no. 709). Read in the public Internet Archive scan le-opere-di-galileo-galilei-edizione-nazionale-volume-11 (a Gallica/BnF digitization); the individual volume's imprint year was not verified from the scan and the series range is recorded instead. No exact artifact is registered here.

edition.title: Le Opere di Galileo Galilei, Edizione Nazionale, volume XI (Carteggio 1611-1613)

alternate_titles: Edizione Nazionale delle Opere di Galileo
work.author: Galileo Galilei; edited by Antonio Favaro
work.description: The twenty-volume national edition of Galileo's works and correspondence (Florence: Barbera, 1890-1909), edited by Antonio Favaro, printing the Vatican trial dossier and the correspondence with diplomatic notes. The controlling witness for the Bellarmine-Galileo documents used in this repository: the 1611 letters, the 12 April 1615 letter to Foscarini, the February-March 1616 Holy Office and Index documents, and the 26 May 1616 certificate in its two dossier witnesses.
work.title: Le Opere di Galileo Galilei, Edizione Nazionale
